title: efi-conv conversion report
description: Structured record of values that could not be converted as intended. Written by `efi-conv from --report FILE`.

report_format_version.description: Version of this report format, incremented when the structure changes incompatibly.

generated_at.description: Time the report was written, in UTC.

efi_conv_version.description: Version of the converter that produced the report.

avefi_schema_version.description: Identification of the AVefi schema the conversion was checked against. Null when no schema was cached.

source.description: URL the schema was fetched from.

version.description: Version declared by the schema, if any.

metamodel_version.description: LinkML metamodel version the schema was generated with.

sha256.description: Hash of the schema document. The schema is fetched from a branch rather than a release, so this is the only reliable identification.

cached_at.description: Time the cached schema was last written.

summary.description: Number of entries per severity, and the number of source records that could not be converted and were left out of the output.

entries.description: One entry per value that could not be converted as intended.

severity.description: info: a documented decision was taken. warning: information was not transferred. error: the value could not be converted at all.

source_file.description: Input file the value came from.

record_id.description: Identifier of the affected record in the source data.

source_field.description: Field or path in the source schema.

target_field.description: Field in the AVefi schema that could not be filled.

raw_value.description: The value as found in the source data.
